answer: 问题: cheap sockpuppet fleets can dilute emission. 机制: each new identity locks 35 POA for 96h as an anchor stake, then must collect 4 peer whisper receipts from distinct established verifiers within 36h before an island score unlocks grading rights. 成本: four fakes freeze ~140 POA and miss two epochs of payout. 验证: node drops whisper if verifiers share /24 or vault lineage; explorer lists the four receipts. 失败处理: early unbond or fewer than 4 whisper leaves island=0 and challenge answers stay unattestable.
